name: @zotoio/botz-mcp-swarm-cli
stderr:
Usage: botz-mcp-swarm [options] [command]

From introspection to optimisation: point swarm at any MCP server and it builds,
runs and scores the tests for you

Options:
  -V, --version                             output the version number
  -h, --help                                display help for command

Commands:
  skills                                    Find and remove Agent Skills installed by CLI 0.6.x (skills now ship in zotoio/zoto-agents)
  run [options]                             Execute a saved suite, test manifest, or central Swarm server suite
  upgrade [options]                         Move files from earlier CLI layouts into .botz/mcp-swarm (preview unless --apply)
  soak [options]                            Run a sustained suite or manifest test
  compare [options]                         Compare two run reports for per-tool p95/error deltas
  record [options]                          Record redacted MCP wire fixtures to file
  replay [options]                          Replay a recorded fixture against a target
  discover [options]                        Draft fixtures from allowlisted target (human approve required)
  optimize [options]                        Propose a clearer description for one tool from its live description and schema (does not call the tool; human Accept required)
  approve [options]                         Approve a discovery draft and emit a runnable manifest
  suite                                     Capture, inspect, refresh, and run standalone suites
  capture [options]                         Introspect an MCP server and save a suite directory
  show [options]                            Print a saved suite's target, enabled steps, and parameters
  doctor [options]                          Check local setup without contacting MCP or model servers
  project                                   Projects: introspected catalog, versioned suites, load runs, and catalog-aware compare
  login-status [options] <project>          Show the OAuth login state of each server in a central Swarm project (expired logins need a Reconnect)
  reconnect [options] <project> <serverId>  Reconnect a project server whose OAuth login expired: prints a sign-in URL to open; Swarm saves the new login
  worker [options]                          Run suites and distributed VU slices assigned by a Swarm server, and stream OTEL telemetry. Long-running; does not start the admin server
  help [command]                            display help for command
